answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Conferred shepherd registration with shepherds association attestation changes that arithmetic: a registration the association renews after flock audits, so the mesa for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the meadow is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the plume of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
